provenance.initial_XDF_snapshot: Before snapshot in corrected-fit run byte-identical to original XDF_selected; saved before_sector row is paired with original XDF14; CDF final_sector row is paired with that run final.npz
provenance.reuse: Do not rerun any old scientific entry. Saved rank14 arrays and prior physical-sector errors only; no new fit/rank search/norm.

conditions.product_formula: ordered symmetric S2; all original frames; no PR split

allowances.state_coverage: control0 full-Fock random; control1 sector basis/complex/own-ground; control+ own-ground
allowances.synthesis_policy: finite probe residuals are not global operator norm bounds

validation_scope.local: All15 blocks per arm once at tau1/20: original-g corrected kappa+scalar for block0, original raw density frames otherwise. One seeded complex-sector probe under control+ per local, all full controlled output amplitudes retained.
validation_scope.kernels: Four candidates x literal/shared routes at h=1/(10*s); control0 full-Fock complex random probe, control1 sector first basis/seeded complex/own-ground, and control+ own-ground. Raw/reference, compiled/raw and compiled/reference compared, no phase fit; state norm drift checked.
validation_scope.references: Independent original h/g/c and saved J/U CAR sector local expm; saved PF kernels for complete ordered evolution; never project individual Gaussian gates to sector. Qiskit/Aer simulates all8192 amplitudes.
validation_scope.actual_adjoint: For each of8 circuits, inverse of actual raw and compiled circuit applied to its own forward control+ ground output; compare original input.
validation_scope.shells: Shared head H, X H+measure, Y Sdg then H+measure; P0 compile separately. Require no system gate, compare full ancilla2x2 matrices and unitarity through existing numerical_segment. Not a full8192 matrix.
validation_scope.XY: For each candidate/route, raw and compiled head -> kernel repeated s times -> separate X/Y tails, on supplied own-DF ground. Compare with <psi|saved_kernel^s|psi> at m0, total time.1; no quantum sampling, no long-round build.
validation_scope.round_synthesis: 8 circuit routes x13 rows of occurrence count n=s*2^m. Reuse old analytic telescoping entry with global kernel distance=None; all complex/rigorous error bounds stay None/UNRESOLVED_FINITE_PROBES. Never multiply probe maximum by n as a bound.
validation_scope.costs: Exact deterministic P0 metrics on8 kernels +3 shells; compare CDF/XDF at same s and route, plus literal/shared per candidate. One h-step kernel only. No shots, per-shot/interrogation totals, final CA, or grand resource evaluation.

simulation_policy.backend: existing qiskit-aer0.15.1 CPU double statevector, batching finite input states; no new numerical library
simulation_policy.gate_conversion: Existing Qiskit Operator only for <=3 qubit gates; larger composites traversed via official definitions, all phases retained. Converted small UnitaryGate circuits used only for simulation, never for cost metrics.
simulation_policy.declared_phase: Strip declared circuit global_phase before Aer set_statevector and restore exp(i*declared_phase) after evolution, following existing simulate_statevector convention. No fitted phase and no installed-package edits.
simulation_policy.sampling: No measurements in simulated bodies; Aer shots=1 is deterministic save-state plumbing only, not RPE shots or statistical resource evaluation.
simulation_policy.input_state_preparation: Simulator set_statevector supplies probes/oracle; physical circuit state preparation excluded
simulation_policy.matrix_sizes: One state8192 complex entries128KiB, probe batch5; individual gate matrix<=8, independent local reference<=400. No8192x8192 or4096x4096 unitary.

fairness.number_emitter: Both saved J/U arms use existing general-K number adapter + NativeBuilder.prepare_cdf with label changed for XDF; no one-arm square-root decomposition or custom optimizations
fairness.sharing: Existing NativeBuilder.runs: only adjacent exactly identical rotations share basis; combined_diagonal uses math.fsum/exact-zero rule in that run; literal keeps original runs
fairness.boundary: Separate kernel/head/readout compilation; no unobserved inter-kernel/inter-segment compiler reduction assumed
fairness.relative_Gaussian_fusion: Not implemented in current NativeBuilder; no new relative-frame fusion adopted. General Gaussian relative products would change comparison recipe and need separate design/adoption.

call_definition.saved_bundle_load: One original input, saved CDF/XDF14 arrays, paired saved DF norm/guard+optimizer, saved PF result, two own-ground states and four PF kernels; schema/finite/identity/previous eligibility checks included, no DF/PF recomputation
call_definition.native_model: Two existing general-K/native model preparations, including existing one-body diagonalization (not DF fit or ground solve)
call_definition.sector_generators: Two original ordered CAR block batches for independent local references; no DF residual norm
call_definition.gaussian_build: 30 ordered basis-materialization requests (15 per arm) through existing NativeBuilder._basis/cache; actual unique materializations <=30, no new Gaussian synthesizer
call_definition.local_reference: 30 independent sector400 raw CAR expm references, each tau1/20
call_definition.circuit_build: 30 raw local controlled factors +8 literal/shared S2 kernels +3 raw head/readout shells =41
call_definition.local_action: 30 raw local factors applied in full8192 state space to one control+ complex-sector probe each, compared to independent sector local action embedded in full space
call_definition.compile: 8 kernels +3 shells through unchanged P0 compiled_wrapper and existing CompileSerialCalls mutex; no compile of local factors or long repeats
call_definition.shell_assessment: 3 existing numerical_segment comparisons on extracted ancilla2x2 operator/ideal, preserving declared phase and rejecting system operations
call_definition.kernel_action: 8 bundles: raw and compiled full state action batches of5 probes, raw/reference and compiled/raw/reference max-component/norm checks, no operator-norm claim
call_definition.adjoint_action: 8 bundles: actual raw/compiled circuit inverse applied to own forward control+ ground output
call_definition.hadamard_action: 8 bundles: raw/compiled actual head +s kernel actions +X/Y readouts at base time.1, compare complex reference and each other; no shots
call_definition.metrics: 11 existing circuit_metrics calls on P0 kernels8/shells3, including RZ/CX counts/depth and total depth
call_definition.round_synthesis: 104 registered rows (8 routes x13) of analytic occurrence mapping and explicit unqualified global synthesis fields; no numeric PF/CA/shots/resources
call_definition.cost_comparison: 4 same-s/route CDF-vs-XDF comparisons +4 literal-vs-shared candidate comparisons, at native kernel metric level only

STOP.identity_schema_nonfinite_phase_rotation: First correctness failure: stop dependent calls, drain already started tasks, save partial QPY/JSON/calls and original traceback; no tolerance relaxation or fallback
STOP.unknown_synthesis: Record UNRESOLVED_FINITE_PROBES; native probe/metric work may complete, but no CA/shots/total cost or rigorous operator claim
STOP.completion: Mandatory STOP after publication/remote verification; no next science automatically

performance: Reuse existing Gaussian/native/P0/metrics/CAR/PF assets. Aer CPU local-matrix gate input avoids slow Python full-circuit evolution and giant unitary matrices; artificial tests cross-check against independent existing Qiskit Statevector. Prepare shared basis/build objects sequentially; dominant local expm/state actions and8 candidate jobs parallel via resource_plan, Aer thread count from affinity/quota/workers, BLAS coordination. Only compile serialized for known Qiskit borrowing issue. No artificial CPU/RAM/worker/wall cap; inspect actual free resources, no shared settings/other-user changes.
qualification: Finite-probe numerical pilot correctness/cost only; no full controlled operator proof, no global kernel synthesis norm bound, no rigorous CA or total-resource superiority. Full400/800-column state-action or additional justified structural/enclosure evidence is a separate future scope if needed.
permission_policy: Separate explicit science permission in chat only; no approval proof/record/certificate/new grant. Old SOURCE/raw results/grants/ledgers/markers/STOP remain immutable.
